tonight.headline: Ahead by 17, projected to lose: 46 points sat on your bench
body: Bad news first. Kyle Monangai ran 30 times for 146 yards and two touchdowns and scored 28.0 on your bench, then left with a thumb injury. Ollie Gordon had 18.0 on the bench with his game still going. Garrett Wilson caught three passes for 5.7. You lead 97.6 to 80.2, but ESPN has it finishing 109 to 125 against you, a 24% chance: Aye-Aye still have Amon-Ra St. Brown and Tetairoa McMillan tonight, and you have only Alvin Kamara on Monday.

Nothing to do. The lineup was the projection lineup, and the projection had Tuten (12.7) over Monangai (8.3); no brief overrode it. Kamara is already in the flex. The next decision is Tuesday's waiver run, and Monangai is no longer the obvious drop for it.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Aye-Aye's Kyren Williams scored 36.7 in the flex. They left Aaron Jones (16.3 at the snapshot) on the bench. Still to come for them: St. Brown (20.2) and McMillan (15.9) tonight in Carolina, where Coker is unlikely to play; McCaffrey (6.3) and Herbert (6.6) were in progress.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: St. Brown and McMillan combining for under 25 tonight, with Kamara at or above his 10.6 on Monday. Nothing on your side can be changed to help it.

whatWentWrong.title: Monangai scored 28.0 on your bench, and he was Tuesday's drop
whatWentWrong.lead: Every brief since Thursday named him as the seat to give up for a receiver. Today he carried 30 times.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: 30 carries, 146 yards, two touchdowns (archive); 10 carries in each of the first three weeks. D'Andre Swift was healthy and active, got 15 carries, fumbled in the third quarter and then barely played. Ben Johnson denied benching him (RotoWire, 4 Oct). Monangai left late with a thumb injury that is 'being evaluated' (Heavy).

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Tuesday's claim. There is no Do-first card today because nothing can be added or dropped before then; Tuesday's run has to name a different drop or make the case again from Monday's thumb news. The lineup call itself was the projection's, 12.7 to 8.3, and gets no new rule.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: The thumb ruling him out for a stretch, or Johnson saying on Monday that Swift is still the starter: either puts him back in the comparison.

whatWentWrong.title: The receiver room is still three down, and one of them now has a bye
whatWentWrong.lead: Jefferson and McLaurin were inactive, Coker is unlikely tonight and Carolina are off in Week 5.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Jefferson is reported 'hopeful' for Week 5 (Fowler via NBC Sports, 3 Oct). McLaurin was held out as a precaution with no timeline (AP, 4 Oct). Coker can't play before 18 Oct whatever happens tonight. Wilson's 5.7 came on four targets in a 15-pass game, with no injury.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Tuesday's claim again: Metcalf or Boston is still the move, and it matters more if Jefferson's Wednesday practice doesn't match the report. Claims process before that practice, so the claim goes in either way.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing before Tuesday. A full Wednesday from both Jefferson and McLaurin would make the added receiver depth rather than a starter.
